reviews.t: Amazing quality for a great price
reviews.x: Amazing quality for a great price! I previously purchased the jaguar kabuki brush and I fell in love it, I had to go back for more. The sellers emailed me after each purchase with tips on how to use their products, which I found very helpful. All of the brushes are very soft and the kit includes a great variety for different uses. Its beautifully packaged and the case is nice and sturdy so I know these brushes with be in good use for a long time.

I have had these for about 6 months now and I am slowly becoming more and more unimpressed. The brush heads are not as soft as I was expecting. They were alright in the beginning, but now I only use about two brushes from the whole set. It's a great starter kit for someone young, but if you use expensive makeup, I do not recommend these.

reviews.t: the packaging is absolutely adorable. I actually kept the box after receiving this ...
reviews.x: Okay, first off, the packaging is absolutely adorable. I actually kept the box after receiving this a year ago. The makeup bag it comes in is great quality and is a huge plus for this brush set. The brushes are so soft and apply my makeup flawlessly! I will be buying from them again.

reviews.t: Five star brushes at a three star price!
reviews.x: This set is great! Brushes are soft and they work great! This is by far the best deal I've gotten on a set of quality brushes. The case is a bit large but I carry it everywhere anyway because I can't imagine using any other brushes anymore.
What a fantastic purchase! The best make up brush set ever! So soft, organized and does not shed! I love the presentatioa and I am in love now with Bella and Bear products! Just adorbs :)

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brushes as very soft and high quality.
Many customers consider the set a great value for the price.
The packaging and included case are commonly described as cute and convenient.
Some reviewers report that the brushes shed, especially the eye blending brushes.
Customers often highlight the brand's helpful customer service and follow-up communication.
